attchmntText: Touchwood Entertainment Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: Touchwood Entertainment Limited has filed its un-audited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026 with the National Stock Exchange. The results were published in the requisite newspaper on 14th November 2026. This filing is made in compliance with Regulation 47 of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations 2015. The company requests the exchange to take the information on record. The submission includes the attached financial results document.

attchmntText: Touchwood: Integrated filing (Financial) for the Second quarter & Half yearly ended 30th September, 2026
voiceSummary: Touchwood Entertainment Limited filed its integrated financial results for the second quarter and half-year ended 30th September 2026. The company reported a variation in the utilization of funds raised through a preferential issue of equity share warrants on 28th February 2023. The total amount raised was Rs. 14,28,00,000. Shareholders approved the change in objects on 29th September 2023. Funds were reallocated from general corporate purposes to capital expenditures and subsidiary growth. Rs. 2,50,00,000 was utilized for subsidiary business expansion. Rs. 33,215,690 was spent on capital expenditures for business expansion and asset purchases. Rs. 1,78,00,000 was used for working capital and general corporate purposes. The company forfeited Rs. 5,10,00,000 representing the upfront amount for 20,00,000 warrants that were not converted by 31st August 2024. The Audit Committee reviewed and approved the variation.

attchmntText: Touchwood Entertainment Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Touchwood Entertainment Limited announced the outcome of its Board Meeting held on November 13, 2026. The Board considered and approved the Un-Audited Financial Results, both Standalone and Consolidated, for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. These results were recommended by the Audit Committee. The Company also took on record the Limited Review Reports issued by the Statutory Auditors on such financial results. Copies of the Un-Audited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results and the Limited Review Reports are enclosed with the announcement. The information will be made available on the Company's website at www.touchwood.in. Rishabh Mishra, Company Secretary and Compliance Officer, signed the communication on behalf of Touchwood Entertainment Limited.
